### Radical-cure treatment by G6PD status

| G6PD category | Radical-cure treatment policy | Treatment implementation | Implementation details | Health-system level | Health-system details | Implementation year | Additional safety recommendations |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **G6PD normal male: no definition** | PQ 0.5 mg/kg/day over 14 days | Partially implemented | Implemented with G6PD testing where available | Up to the health centre level | Up to the health centre level | 2024 | Medical supervision |
| **G6PD normal female: no definition** | PQ 0.25 mg/kg/day over 14 days | Partially implemented | Implemented with G6PD testing where available | Up to the health centre level | Up to the health centre level | 2024 | Medical supervision |
| **G6PD deficient: no definition** | No PQ or PQ 0.75 mg/kg/week weekly for 8 weeks | Implemented | Implemented with G6PD testing where available | Up to the health centre level | Up to the health centre level | 2024 | Close medical supervision with access to blood transfusion |
| **If no testing available** | PQ 0.25 mg/kg/day over 14 days | Implemented | Implemented with G6PD testing where available | Up to the health centre level | Up to the health centre level | 2024 | Close medical supervision |
:::

### Country-specific policy context

<div class="country-policy-context"><p>High dose short course PQ will soon piloted in active foci areas, followed by National roll out. Also, thinking of Tafenoquine after approval for use from WHO, with support from research outcomes.</p></div>
